source.notes: Every registry:ui item is listed. `bases` lists primitive sets when an item is not in all of radix, base, and aria. `form` has no files in the index; the Forms guide builds on `field`. Blocks and the typography page (utility classes, nothing to install) are not listed.

capabilities.anchored-panel: Opens a panel positioned against its trigger.
capabilities.app-shell: Frames the whole app layout and its navigation.
capabilities.confirmation: Asks the user to confirm a consequential action.
capabilities.content-group: Groups related content into one bounded unit.
capabilities.contextual-hint: Explains a control or item on hover or focus.
capabilities.conversation: Renders chat turns or system notes in a conversation.
capabilities.data-entry: Captures user input for a form or setting.
capabilities.date-input: Selects a date or date range.
capabilities.dense-content: Keeps a lot of content compact on screen.
capabilities.details: Shows full details of one item.
capabilities.empty-state: Explains an empty view and the next step.
capabilities.file-attachment: Shows files or images attached or being uploaded.
capabilities.filter: Narrows a record set by criteria.
capabilities.focused-task: Isolates one short task from the page.
capabilities.identity: Represents a person or account visually.
capabilities.layout-split: Splits the view into user-resizable panes.
capabilities.list-items: Lays out rows in a vertical list.
capabilities.menu: Lists commands or links behind a trigger or bar.
capabilities.mobile-panel: Works as a panel on small screens.
capabilities.multi-step: Walks through a sequence of steps.
capabilities.numeric-range: Sets a number or range by dragging.
capabilities.pagination: Pages through a long record set.
capabilities.peer-views: Offers alternative views of one context.
capabilities.progress: Shows progress toward a known end.
capabilities.quick-action: Runs commands without leaving the page.
capabilities.row-actions: Acts on one record in a list or table.
capabilities.secondary-task: Hosts a task beside the main page.
capabilities.sort: Orders records by a column or key.
capabilities.status: Labels the state of an item or process.
capabilities.submit: Submits a set of inputs as one action.
capabilities.summary: Summarizes key facts at a glance.
capabilities.tabular-data: Shows records in rows and columns.
capabilities.toolbar: Groups related controls in one row.
capabilities.validation: Checks input and blocks invalid submission.
capabilities.wayfinding: Shows where the user is in a hierarchy.

components.use_when: Users open a few of many independent sections, such as FAQs or settings groups.
components.avoid_when: Content users must compare side by side, or a single toggle region (use collapsible).

components.use_when: A persistent in-page message explains state, risk, or a required next step.
components.avoid_when: Transient confirmations (use sonner) or blocking decisions (use alert-dialog).

components.use_when: A destructive or irreversible action needs explicit confirmation before it runs.
components.avoid_when: Routine tasks, forms, or anything a user can undo.

components.use_when: Images, video, or embeds must hold a fixed ratio to avoid layout shift.
components.avoid_when: Text content or elements whose height follows their content.

components.use_when: Users see uploaded files or images with name, size, upload state, and remove actions.
components.avoid_when: Plain links to documents with no upload state.

components.use_when: A person, team, or account needs a compact visual identity with an initials fallback.
components.avoid_when: Decorative images or product imagery.

components.use_when: A short label marks status, category, or a count next to other content.
components.avoid_when: Clickable actions (use button) or long text.

components.use_when: Users move up a deep hierarchy and need to see where they are.
components.avoid_when: Flat apps with one or two levels.

components.use_when: Chat turns render as message bubbles with alignment, grouping, and reactions.
components.avoid_when: Threaded comments or documents.

components.use_when: Users trigger one action; variants set its emphasis.
components.avoid_when: Navigation between pages that should be a link.

components.use_when: Several related actions sit together as one connected control.
components.avoid_when: Mutually exclusive options that hold state (use toggle-group).

components.use_when: Users pick a date or range from an always-visible month grid.
components.avoid_when: Compact fields where a popover picker fits (use date-picker).

components.use_when: A bounded, self-contained item needs a title, metadata, and its own actions.
components.avoid_when: Purely visual grouping on dashboards, or wrapping a whole hero.

components.use_when: Users browse a sequence of media without comparing items at once.
components.avoid_when: Content users must compare or scan; key information hidden on later slides.

components.use_when: Trends, distributions, or comparisons are clearer as a chart than as numbers.
components.avoid_when: One or two values (use a stat in a card) or data users must read exactly (use table).

components.use_when: Users select any number of options, or accept one condition in a form.
components.avoid_when: Settings that apply immediately (use switch).

components.use_when: One region shows or hides extra detail in place.
components.avoid_when: Many peer sections (use accordion or tabs).

components.use_when: Users pick one value from a long list by typing to filter.
components.avoid_when: Fewer than about seven options (use select or radio-group).

components.use_when: Users search and run actions or jump anywhere from a keyboard palette.
components.avoid_when: The only way to reach a feature; novice-only audiences.

components.use_when: Power users right-click an item for its secondary actions.
components.avoid_when: The only path to an action; touch-first screens.

components.use_when: A short focused task interrupts the page and returns the user when done.
components.avoid_when: Long or multi-step work, or content users need beside the page (use sheet).

components.use_when: The app supports right-to-left languages and components must mirror.
components.avoid_when: Single-direction apps with no RTL locale.

components.use_when: On touch screens a bottom panel holds a secondary task or options.
components.avoid_when: Desktop side panels with persistent details (use sheet).

components.use_when: A trigger opens a short list of actions, such as per-row actions.
components.avoid_when: Choosing a form value (use select) or site navigation (use navigation-menu).

components.use_when: A list, table, or page has no content yet and must explain the next step.
components.avoid_when: Loading states (use skeleton) or errors (use alert).

components.use_when: Form controls need a label, description, and error message with correct ARIA wiring.
components.avoid_when: Display-only values.

components.use_when: An existing codebase already uses the legacy react-hook-form wrapper.
components.avoid_when: New forms; build them with field plus your form library.

components.use_when: Pointer users preview rich details, such as a profile, on hover.
components.avoid_when: Essential information or touch-first screens (hover never fires).

components.use_when: Users type a single line of text, email, number, or password.
components.avoid_when: Multi-line text (use textarea) or a fixed set of options.

components.use_when: An input needs icons, prefixes, suffixes, or inline buttons attached.
components.avoid_when: Plain fields with nothing attached (use input).

components.use_when: Users enter a one-time code split into boxes.
components.avoid_when: Passwords or free text.

components.use_when: Rows in a list show media, title, description, and actions in a consistent layout.
components.avoid_when: Tabular data with columns users compare (use table).

components.use_when: The UI shows a keyboard shortcut or key name.
components.avoid_when: Interactive controls; this only displays keys.

components.use_when: A standalone control needs an accessible visible label.
components.avoid_when: Controls already wrapped in field, which includes a label.

components.use_when: A conversation shows a system note, inline status, or labeled separator.
components.avoid_when: Page-level alerts (use alert).

components.use_when: A desktop-style app needs a persistent File/Edit/View menu row.
components.avoid_when: Websites or mobile layouts.

components.use_when: A chat turn needs avatar, header, footer, and sender alignment.
components.avoid_when: Comments on documents or email-style threads.

components.use_when: A chat transcript streams replies, loads history, and keeps the latest turn anchored.
components.avoid_when: Static lists or short logs (use scroll-area).

components.use_when: A single choice must use the platform picker, especially on mobile.
components.avoid_when: Options that need icons, search, or rich content (use select or combobox).

components.use_when: A site header links to top-level sections, with optional rich flyouts.
components.avoid_when: App navigation with many sections (use sidebar).

components.use_when: Users step through pages of results with a known total.
components.avoid_when: Feeds better suited to load-more or infinite scroll.

components.use_when: A small interactive panel opens next to its trigger.
components.avoid_when: Plain hints (use tooltip) or tasks that need full focus (use dialog).

components.use_when: A task shows how far it has advanced toward a known end.
components.avoid_when: Unknown durations (use spinner).

components.use_when: Users answer a guided sequence of questions with skip, back, and progress.
components.avoid_when: Short forms that fit one screen (use field).

components.use_when: Users pick one of a few options that should all stay visible.
components.avoid_when: More than about seven options (use select).

components.use_when: Users resize adjacent panels such as a list and a detail pane.
components.avoid_when: Mobile layouts or fixed page structure.

components.use_when: A bounded region scrolls with consistent styled scrollbars.
components.avoid_when: The main page scroll.

components.use_when: Users pick one value from a short-to-medium list in a compact control.
components.avoid_when: Long lists that need typing (use combobox).

components.use_when: Adjacent groups need a visual or semantic divider.
components.avoid_when: Spacing alone already separates the groups.

components.use_when: Supporting details or a secondary task open beside the page, keeping context.
components.avoid_when: Short confirmations (use alert-dialog).

components.use_when: An app needs persistent, collapsible navigation across many sections.
components.avoid_when: Marketing sites or apps with three or fewer destinations.

components.use_when: Content is loading and its layout is known, so placeholders prevent shift.
components.avoid_when: Unknown layouts or quick actions (use spinner).

components.use_when: Users set an approximate value or range where the exact number matters little.
components.avoid_when: Exact numeric entry (use input).

components.use_when: Brief, non-blocking feedback confirms an action or reports a background event.
components.avoid_when: Errors users must act on (use alert) or essential content.

components.use_when: A short wait with unknown duration, often inside a button.
components.avoid_when: Known progress (use progress) or page loads with known layout (use skeleton).

components.use_when: A setting turns on or off and applies immediately.
components.avoid_when: Choices submitted with a form (use checkbox).

components.use_when: Static rows and columns users read and compare.
components.avoid_when: Sorting, filtering, or paging (use data-table).

components.use_when: A few peer views share one page context.
components.avoid_when: Sequential steps or more than about six views.

components.use_when: Users write multi-line text.
components.avoid_when: Single values (use input).

components.use_when: Brief, non-blocking feedback in the Base UI primitive set.
components.avoid_when: Radix or Aria projects (use sonner).

components.use_when: A pressed state turns one formatting or view option on or off.
components.avoid_when: Settings (use switch).

components.use_when: A row of options shows which are active, such as view mode or text style.
components.avoid_when: Form values submitted later (use radio-group).

components.use_when: Icon-only controls need a short text label on hover and focus.
components.avoid_when: Essential or interactive content (use popover).

components.use_when: Users compare, sort, filter, and act on structured records.
components.avoid_when: Fewer than about ten static rows (use table).

components.use_when: Users pick a date or range in a compact field that opens a calendar.
components.avoid_when: Dates users know exactly and type faster (use input).

styles.summary: Monochrome, compact product UI; content and data carry the page, chrome stays quiet.
styles.avoid_when: Brand-led marketing pages or playful consumer apps.

styles.summary: Reading-first pages with a serif display face, warm paper neutrals, and generous measure.
styles.avoid_when: Dense tools where users scan tables or act fast.

styles.summary: Dark-first operator console: tight rows, sharp corners, cyan focus, mono for values.
styles.avoid_when: First-time or non-technical users; long-form reading.

styles.summary: Soft, rounded self-service flows with calm teal actions and roomy touch targets.
styles.avoid_when: Expert tools that need many rows on screen.

styles.summary: Precise, trustworthy money and account screens: deep blue actions, tabular figures, restrained depth.
High-energy launch and marketing pages: grotesk display type, vivid violet, lifted surfaces.
styles.avoid_when: Daily-use tools; screens where calm focus matters.

styles.summary: Plain, legible public-service forms: hyperlegible type, strong borders, obvious focus.
Developer docs and references: neutral zinc, emerald links and actions, mono for code.
Colorful consumer app: big rounded corners, coral actions, bouncy but brief feedback.
styles.avoid_when: Finance, health, or enterprise admin screens.

styles.summary: Minimal premium surfaces: square corners, near-black on warm white, serif display, lots of air.
